# ToteMove

> Reusable plastic moving tote rentals near Brampton, ON. Delivered across 10 towns in Peel, Halton Hills, and Dufferin. Flat-rate from $119.

ToteMove is a moving tote rental service based in Brampton, Ontario, Canada, founded by Steven Paiva. Instead of buying cardboard boxes, customers rent industrial-strength reusable plastic totes delivered 7 days before move day with a dolly included. Flat-rate packages start at $119 for a studio or 1-bedroom move and go up to $389 for a 5-bedroom move. The 14-day rental window covers 7 days to pack and 7 days to unpack. Totes are 24 × 20 × 12 inches, hold up to 60 lbs each, and are rated for 400+ reuse cycles.

## Service Area

Brampton, Mississauga (North), Caledon, Georgetown, Halton Hills, Acton, Hillsburgh, Erin, Orangeville, Bolton — 10 towns across Peel Region, Halton Hills, and Dufferin County, Ontario.

## Pricing

- Studio / 1-Bedroom: $119 flat-rate (10 totes + dolly)
- 1 Bedroom Plus: $149 flat-rate (15 totes + dolly)
- 2-Bedroom: $189 flat-rate (20 totes + dolly)
- 3-Bedroom: $229 flat-rate (25 totes + dolly)
- 4-Bedroom: $299 flat-rate (35 totes + dolly)
- 5-Bedroom: $389 flat-rate (45 totes + dolly)

All packages include delivery, pickup, and a dolly. Extended rental: $1.50/tote/week after 14 days.
